verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with a substantial software stack (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, container toolkit), so asking whether it lets users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions vendor telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The Device Metrics Exporter and Omnistat produce GPU metrics for the operator's own monitoring, which is a different feature from a privacy opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
